reader_notes: Cloze unit. Each gap has exactly one option that fits both sense and collocation; the three foils in every set are real English words from the same morphological family (over-, un-, s-, rem-), which is the right kind of difficulty.
Gap (4) 'slipped' is the only one of the four that can pair with the preceding 'had not risen with them but ___'; 'soared' and 'swelled' are ruled out by the contrast, 'sprouted' by collocation.

Argument is internally consistent end to end: distributor takes more than half of opening-week box office, so the counter carries the margin; the half-price experiment raised admissions ~4% but lowered takings, which supports rather than undercuts the thesis.
